stemMd: In a standard isometric drawing, how many mutually perpendicular spatial axes are represented by three equally spaced directions in the image plane?
explanationMd: Isometric projection treats the three perpendicular coordinate directions equally. Their positive projected directions are conventionally separated by120°. Opposite rays do not create additional independent axes.

distractorRationale.c: An isometric view represents all three spatial coordinate directions.
distractorRationale.d: A third direction represents height or depth.
distractorRationale.e: Euclidean three-dimensional space has three coordinate axes here.
distractorRationale.b: Opposite rays belong to the same three axes.
